title: Runtime in hours and minutes
statementMd:
Show each title with its runtime formatted like `2h 28m`.

Expected columns: `title`, `runtime`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT title, (runtime_minutes / 60) || 'h ' || (runtime_minutes % 60) || 'm' AS runtime FROM movies;
```
